Definition
[Distortion and epsilon-isometry] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0415 ↗ def:chow-iii-gromov-hausdorff-distance 1. appG:G.10\group Gromov–Hausdorff convergence

The distortion of $f:(X,d_X)\to (Y,d_Y)$ is $\operatorname {dis}f=\sup _{x,x'}|d_X(x,x')-d_Y(fx,fx')|$. An $\epsilon $-net meets every point within $\epsilon $, and an $\epsilon $-isometry has distortion at most $\epsilon $ and image an $\epsilon $-net.
